meta.title: 婚纱照修图进行🀄️还原美貌过程

scenes.context: 开场高倍检视：皮肤折痕、痣点与深色椅面边界，钢笔光标停在轮廓线上。放大检视皮肤上的每一个小瑕疵。
sentences: 放大检视皮肤折痕和痣点。
Zoomed in on creases, moles, and edges.
钢笔光标停在轮廓线上。
The pen cursor pauses on the contour line.
scenes.speak: Zoomed in on creases, moles, and edges. The pen cursor pauses on the contour line.

scenes.context: 液化网格覆盖颈侧：针对横纹做局部变形，而非全局磨皮。针对颈纹做局部液化，避免整个皮肤被磨平。
sentences: A liquify grid spreads over the neck.
局部变形而非全局磨皮。
scenes.speak: A liquify grid spreads over the neck. Local warping, not global smoothing.

scenes.context: 侧光人像工作视图：暖光勾勒下颌与颈前，蕾丝婚纱细节清晰。在侧光下检查轮廓和高光的处理。
sentences: Warm light traces the jaw and front neck.
scenes.speak: Warm light traces the jaw and front neck. Lace wedding details stay sharp.

scenes.context: 轮廓蒙版：选区沿头、颈、肩剪影行进，为后续换背景或局部处理做准备。沿人物轮廓建立蒙版，便于后续处理。
sentences: 选区沿头颈肩剪影行进。
The selection follows the head-neck-shoulder outline.
scenes.speak: The selection follows the head-neck-shoulder outline. It preps a background swap.

scenes.context: 高倍局部润饰：笔刷落在颈侧阴影过渡带，界面显示约245%缩放。在245%缩放下精修阴影过渡。
sentences: 笔刷处理颈侧阴影过渡。
The brush works the neck shadow transition.
scenes.speak: The brush works the neck shadow transition. The view shows roughly 245% zoom.

scenes.context: 全身回看：100%视图下检查体态与服装，手臂旁有白色标注线。回到全身，检查体态与服装整体效果。
sentences: At 100% view, checking posture and garment.
A white annotation line sits by the arm.
scenes.speak: At 100% view, checking posture and garment. A white annotation line sits by the arm.

scenes.context: 构图检视：台灯、圆桌与沙发一并入画，确认暖光氛围与整体层次。检查整幅画面的光线氛围与层次。
sentences: 台灯、圆桌与沙发一并入画。
The lamp, table, and sofa all frame in.
Confirming the warm mood and layers.
scenes.speak: The lamp, table, and sofa all frame in. Confirming the warm mood and layers.

scenes.context: 黑白检视：去掉色彩后复查颈肩光影过渡与皮肤干净度。去色检查光影过渡是否干净利落。
sentences: Stripping color to review the light transitions.
Checking how clean the skin looks.
scenes.speak: Stripping color to review the light transitions. Checking how clean the skin looks.

practice: Zoom in hard on creases, moles, and edges first.
Liquify the neck creases locally, never globally.
Build a silhouette mask before swapping the background.
Strip color to check the light transitions.
pitfalls: Local warping and brushes keep the skin real.
245% zoom is where the real detail lives.
A black-and-white pass exposes the transitions.
Posture and garment need a 100% check.
shifts: 用 liquify（液化）、mask（蒙版）、retouch brush（修复笔刷）
用 245% zoom（高倍缩放）、black-and-white check（黑白检视）、transition（过渡）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播与图注。已校正：开场高倍检视皮肤折痕痣点与深色椅面边界钢笔光标停在轮廓线上、液化网格覆盖颈侧针对横纹做局部变形而非全局磨皮、侧光人像工作视图暖光勾勒下颌与颈前蕾丝婚纱细节清晰、轮廓蒙版选区沿头颈肩剪影行进为后续换背景或局部处理做准备、高倍局部润饰笔刷落在颈侧阴影过渡带界面显示约245%缩放、全身回看100%视图下检查体态与服装手臂旁有白色标注线、构图检视台灯圆桌与沙发一并入画确认暖光氛围与整体层次、黑白检视去掉色彩后复查颈肩光影过渡与皮肤干净度。
